items.what: In 2.1.321 (Nov 9, 2026), Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) is added and is now the default Fable model: 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads.
items.test: If you pick Fable without pinning a version, run /model or check your usage after updating to confirm which model you're on, and re-check your per-task cost against the new rates.

items.what: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), ImageResponse.image is removed from @opencode/ai; read response.images[0] instead.
items.test: If your code imports @opencode/ai, search it for .image on image responses and switch to response.images[0] before upgrading.

items.what: In 2.2.7 (Nov 10, 2026), on a Location still loading plugins, SDK agent.list returns the agents loaded so far, and integration.list, usage.limits, vcs.init, rpc.call and artifact.* no longer wait up to 5 seconds.
items.test: If your SDK client lists agents or integrations right after startup, check that plugin-provided entries still show up; refresh on the matching *.updated event.
